revision_relation.statement: The official vLLM recipe describes 1017 as the 2026-10-17 weight refresh: same architecture, config.json, tokenizer, prompt encoding, and same model tensor layout as launch; only model weights change. The NVIDIA training recipe below is therefore recorded as a source-adapted recipe for 1017, not as a 1017 training run.

tokenizer.sha256_basis: SHA-256 published in the upstream README at the same pinned repository revision; source blob SHA-1 and exact UTF-8 byte length were independently checked.
tokenizer.tokenizer_note: The bundled V4.1 tokenizer is a modified copy of the referenced HF tokenizer with image token ID 129264 reassigned to <｜image｜>; other entries match comparison revision 6821d6ad3681a4b137b066b76094fa82ebd0a380. The upstream repository says the original import revision was not recorded.

tokenizer.compatibility_basis: The official vLLM recipe says 1017 and launch share tokenizer/prompt encoding, and the pinned 1017 config uses image_token_id 129264. This is compatibility evidence only; it is not a byte-identity proof for this modified copy.

training_recipe.source_type: Official NVIDIA-NeMo AutoModel H100 recipe, adapted at source level only
training_recipe.model_binding: Source-adapted for canonical 1017 pin based on official vLLM recipe relation above: config/tokenizer/architecture/prompt encoding same; only weights change. No claim the H100 recipe was run on 1017.
training_recipe.training_dtype: bfloat16 (model torch_dtype and FSDP param_dtype; reduction and LM head precision are float32)
training_recipe.source_checkpoint_quantization: FP8 dense, FP4 experts; recipe dequantizes base checkpoint during DCP loading
training_recipe.module_mapping_qualification: These exact dotted module patterns are from the official recipe. No module/class names beyond the source recipe are inferred.

data.note: The NVIDIA recipe caps training at 16,384 train samples and 128 validation samples; these are recipe limits, not full split counts. The immutable train and validation files are pinned by revision, LFS SHA-256 and size. Their temporary downloaded bytes matched those pins, but no payload is retained, no Parquet content/schema or split semantics were inspected, and no reproducible sample manifest/seed receipt exists.
